mu_name_from: MuMain loads helm indexes 10 to 14 from HelmElf{i+1} (ZzzOpenData.cpp line 148: `AccessModel(MODEL_HELM + i + 10, ..., L"HelmElf", i + 1)`), so index 14 is HelmElf05, which openmu's 0.75 Armors.cs names the Guardian Helm. mu.db agrees: code 3598, group 7 index 14, Player/HelmElf05.bmd.
why_this_one: The Fairy Elf's fifth and last 0.75 set, and the one Eo the Craftsman sells after Spirit - all five pieces at +3 on his shelf (src/sim/market.cpp, kCraftsman). Silver plate with gilt edging, the brightest metal in her wardrobe, and the piece that finishes his shelf.
profile_from: armour, not soft_armour. Guardian is polished silver plate with gilt edging on every sheet (upper_03, lower_03, gloves_03b, boots_03b are all grey metal at chroma about 22 with gold scroll along the edges), so plate_steel, the armour default, is what almost all of it is.
keeps_head_from: Not set, which is the rule and the mesh agreeing. The range in ZzzCharacter.cpp line 12122 stops at MODEL_SPIRIT_HELM, helm 13, and the Guardian Helm is 14, so the client sets BODYPART_HEAD to -1 and draws no head under it. It does not need one: 64 of its 162 triangles are on skin_warrior_01, a face inside the helm's own model, as the Leather Helm carries one.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Armors.cs line 67. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.
stats.call_note: ArmorInitializerBase.CreateArmor(number, slot, width, height, name, dropLevel, defense, durability, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel). `armor.Group = (byte)(slot + 5)`, so slot 2 is group 7, 3 is 8 and 4 is 9.
stats.defense_note: Points of defence, in the row and summed into Player.ArmourDefense by Wear - see shared/Rows.cs.
stats.classes_from: The last three ints of the call are 0, 0, 1 - the Fairy Elf alone. Eighty agility beside forty strength is the row saying the same thing in stats.

sheet_from: Data/Player/head_a05.OZJ (64x64) and skin_warrior_01.OZJ (256x256), from MuMain. The .bmd names head_a05.jpg and skin_warrior_01.jpg; 98 of the 162 triangles are on the first and 64 on the skin.
sheet_note: head_a05 is a close silver helm with a sweeping gold crest and a dark eye slot, one large view filling the page. Mean (144, 137, 123) at chroma 40. skin_warrior_01 is the elf's own body sheet: this helm carries its own face, 64 triangles of it, so it needs no head under it.
material_note: Ten islands. Island 9 is 64 triangles, skin_warrior_01's 64 exactly: the face inside the helm, skin. The other nine are head_a05's 98 - the shell at 52 and eight small pieces of 5 or 6 triangles, which are the crest's gold sweeps and the cheek guards in pairs - and take plate_steel. The crest is gold paint on the same plate and goes with it, which is the island rule; it is welded to nothing of its own sheet that would argue for brass.
